label: Richter always saved
summary: Defeating Richter always takes the 'Richter saved' route (the Shaft's-orb cutscene that opens the Inverted Castle) instead of his normal defeat.

edits.why: RicMain lethal-damage path: 'lhu s5,(a0)' -> 'j 0x801B5440' (the existing RicSetStep(0x70) PL_S_ENDING_4 call)

vanilla.reason: The replaced word and the jump-target code (0x801B5440 'jal RicSetStep; ori a0,zero,0x70') are identical in vanilla.

overlaps.detail: 0xB0 bytes before its word at 0x3548C; no overlap.

notes: README: Codex 2026-09-27/read-c-users-omergilla-downloads-castlevania/outputs/Richter-Save-Alternate-Scarlet-Symphony-2.0.README.md. Not emulator-verified by its author. In vanilla the save route needs the Holy Glasses and Shaft's orb; with this the bad-ending branch is skipped.
